resources.string: Reads this device\'s GPS/network coordinates and accuracy and sends them to your family\'s parent account. Without it no location can be shown.
Periodic location while the app is closed
Allows periodic location updates when the app is not on screen. Android requires a separate step: choose \"Allow all the time\" in the settings page that opens.
The phone\'s Location setting must be on, otherwise Android returns no position even if the permission is granted.
Shows alerts (parent) and the visible notice while the app syncs (child device).
Screen time and app usage reports
Lets the app read how long each app was used (not its content). Enabled from a special Android settings page, not a normal dialog.
Some phones stop background work to save battery. Allow the app to run in the background; some brands also need Auto-start enabled.
Live camera stream to parent upon request
Allows streaming live front or rear camera video to parent dashboard, with a persistent notification on your phone.
Live ambient audio stream to parent upon request
Allows streaming live ambient microphone audio to parent dashboard upon on-demand request, with a persistent notification on your phone.
If skipped, this will not work: %1$s
